analytic_reference.note: depletion approximation = sanity/reference range only, not the exact DD solution

bias.continuation: from the 0 V DD state in steps of 0.025 V: forward 0.025, 0.05, 0.075, 0.10; reverse run on a freshly rebuilt device: -0.025, -0.05, -0.075, -0.10; no step changed after results

spec.contacts: left = boundary at x_min (p-side), right = boundary at x_max (n-side); ohmic via production setup_semiconductor_potential_equation / setup_drift_diffusion_equation (simple_physics helpers); top/bottom: no boundary condition (natural zero normal flux)

doping.junction: x = 0 um; p-side x < 0 (NetDoping = -NA), n-side x > 0 (NetDoping = +ND)
doping.node_exactly_at_x0: NetDoping = 0 (symmetric step: its dual cell is half p, half n); same rule for every mesh and 1D

models.generation: SRH (USRH < 0) only; no impact ionization, no optical
models.recombination: SRH only, taun = taup = 1e-8 s (production setup_drift_diffusion_equation), n1 = p1 = n_i

reference_1d.convergence: successive-level differences in V_bi, psi, log10 n, log10 p and bias currents must decrease monotonically with refinement; otherwise ONE_DIMENSIONAL_REFERENCE_NOT_CONVERGED

tolerances.M2_identity_vs_1D_same_dx: |dpsi| <= 1e-9 V at every node; bias current rel diff <= 1e-8 (M2 has the same x-lines as 1D dx=0.02)
tolerances.agreement_vs_1D: potential: max |psi_2D - psi_1D,finest(interp)| <= 3 U_psi + 1e-6 V, U_psi = max |psi_1D,0.02 - psi_1D,finest(interp)|; current: rel diff vs J_1D,finest*H <= 3 U_I + 1e-6, U_I = |J_0.02 - J_finest|/|J_finest|
tolerances.block_sign: expected off-diagonal sign of each same-variable Jacobian block = the sign observed on M2 D0; any strictly opposite sign is a violation
tolerances.overshoot: psi within [psi_left_contact, psi_right_contact] +- 1e-9 V; at 0 V n within [min, max] of contact n values *(1 +- 1e-9), same for p
tolerances.quasi_fermi_eq: max |phi_n - phi_n(median)| and |phi_p - phi_p(median)| <= 1e-6 V at 0 V, phi_n = psi - V_T ln(n/n_i), phi_p = psi + V_T ln(p/n_i)
